articles.learnerContent:
## Samsung Electronics Joins the Physical AI Race with a New Robotics Division

Samsung Electronics, one of the world's largest technology companies, has announced that it is entering the "physical AI" race. The company has created a new division focused entirely on robotics. This is a major step for Samsung as it tries to compete with other leading technology firms around the world.

### What Is Physical AI?

You may already know about AI (artificial intelligence) tools like chatbots, which exist only in software. "Physical AI" is different. It refers to AI technology that is built into real, physical machines — especially robots. These robots can move, sense their environment, and make decisions on their own.

Physical AI robots can be used in many places, such as factories, hospitals, warehouses, and even people's homes. Many technology experts believe that physical AI will be one of the most important technologies of the near future.

### Samsung's New Robotics Division

Samsung has decided to create a dedicated robotics division. "Dedicated" means this team will focus only on robotics — it will not work on other products like smartphones or televisions. This shows how seriously Samsung is taking the robotics business.

By building a separate team, Samsung can move faster and focus more clearly on developing new robotic technologies. Companies often create dedicated divisions when they want to grow quickly in a new area.

### Why Is This Important?

Samsung is not the first company to invest heavily in robotics and physical AI. Other major companies, including Tesla, Boston Dynamics, and several Chinese tech firms, are already developing advanced robots. The competition in this field is growing very fast.

For Samsung, entering this race makes good business sense. The company already has strong skills in manufacturing, semiconductors, and electronics — all of which are needed to build high-quality robots. Samsung can use these existing strengths as it develops its robotics business.

### A Growing Global Trend

Around the world, governments and companies are paying close attention to physical AI. Robots that can work alongside humans — or even replace humans in dangerous or repetitive jobs — could change many industries. Some analysts predict that the global robotics market will be worth hundreds of billions of dollars within the next decade.

For South Korea, Samsung's move is also nationally significant. South Korea is already known for its strength in semiconductors and electronics. If Samsung becomes a leader in physical AI and robotics, it could help South Korea become a global center for this important new technology.

### What Comes Next?

Samsung has not yet revealed specific products or a detailed timeline for its robotics plans. However, the creation of a dedicated division is a clear signal that the company is making robotics a top priority. Industry watchers will be following Samsung's next steps closely.

As the physical AI race continues to grow, Samsung's entry could shake up the competition and bring exciting new developments to the world of robotics.

## David Jonsson Cast as the Next Black Panther

Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige has revealed how actor David Jonsson was chosen to play the next Black Panther. Feige spoke to the film magazine *Empire* and shared the surprising story behind the casting.

### A Secret Meeting

According to Feige, it all began with a "secret meeting" between Jonsson and *Black Panther* director Ryan Coogler. The meeting happened before Marvel had even started an official search for the role. In other words, Coogler moved quickly and quietly to find his leading man.

David Jonsson is best known for his role in the science fiction film *The Long Walk*. He has impressed audiences and critics with his strong performances in recent years.

### Coogler Knew Right Away

Feige said that Coogler identified Jonsson as the right person almost immediately after their meeting. "I got chills," Feige told *Empire*, suggesting that he was very excited when he heard Coogler's choice.

This kind of reaction from the head of Marvel Studios shows just how confident the team feels about Jonsson stepping into such an important role. The Black Panther character is one of the most beloved heroes in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

### Big Shoes to Fill

The original Black Panther, T'Challa, was played by Chadwick Boseman, who passed away in 2020. His performance in the 2018 film *Black Panther* and other Marvel movies was hugely popular around the world. The character returned in *Black Panther: Wakanda Forever* (2022), which honored Boseman's memory.

Now, with *Black Panther 3* in development, Marvel is moving the story forward with a new actor in a new version of the hero. David Jonsson will take on that responsibility.

### Who Is David Jonsson?

Jonsson is a British actor who has been building his career with strong performances in film and television. His casting in such a major Marvel role is a big step forward for him. Fans around the world are already curious to see how he will bring his own style to the iconic Black Panther suit.

### What's Next?

Details about *Black Panther 3* are still limited. Marvel has not yet announced an official release date or shared much about the story. However, with Ryan Coogler returning as director and a new lead actor confirmed, excitement for the project is already growing.

Kevin Feige's comments suggest that Marvel is very happy with the direction of the film. Fans will likely hear more official news in the coming months.

keyVocab.example: The casting of the new superhero surprised many fans.

## Hayley Williams Shares the Stage at Newport Folk Festival

The Newport Folk Festival is one of the most famous music festivals in the United States. It takes place every summer in Newport, Rhode Island, and has a long history of bringing together artists from many different musical styles. This year, the festival once again created some memorable moments.

### Hayley Williams Takes the Stage

Hayley Williams, the lead singer of the rock band Paramore, gave an exciting performance at the festival. She is well known for her powerful voice and energetic stage presence. However, one of the highlights of her set was not just her solo performance — it was the special guests she invited to join her.

### Special Guests Appear

During her performance, Williams brought out Karly Hartzman, the singer from the indie rock band Wednesday. Wednesday is a band from Asheville, North Carolina, and has been gaining a lot of attention in the indie music world in recent years. Hartzman's appearance was a surprise for many fans in the audience.

Williams also welcomed Jenny Lewis to the stage. Lewis is a well-respected singer-songwriter who has been making music for many years. She first became famous as the lead singer of the indie pop band Rilo Kiley, and she has also had a successful solo career.

### More Artists Join In

The surprise guest appearances did not stop there. Several other well-known musicians also came onstage during the festival. Jack Antonoff, a famous musician and music producer who has worked with artists like Taylor Swift and Lana Del Rey, also performed. Lucy Dacus, a popular indie rock singer-songwriter known for her thoughtful lyrics, joined in as well.

Other artists who hopped onstage included This Is Lorelei, Kelsey Lu, and Joy Oladokun. This Is Lorelei is a musical project known for its lo-fi indie sound. Kelsey Lu is a singer and cellist who creates unique and emotional music. Joy Oladokun is a singer-songwriter whose music blends folk, pop, and soul.

### Why These Moments Matter

Unplanned or surprise collaborations like these are one of the things that make live music festivals so special. Fans who attend never know exactly what they might see. When artists from different backgrounds come together on one stage, it creates a unique experience that cannot be repeated.

The Newport Folk Festival has a long tradition of these kinds of surprise moments. Over the years, many legendary performances have happened there, and this year's festival seems to have continued that tradition in a wonderful way.

For fans of Hayley Williams, Wednesday, Jenny Lewis, and all the other artists involved, this was clearly a night to remember.

keyVocab.example: The singer's incredible stage presence kept the audience engaged throughout the entire concert.
The surprise guest was the highlight of the whole show.
The collaboration between the two artists produced a beautiful new song.
It is a tradition at this festival for artists to invite surprise guests onstage.
Her music blends elements of folk and pop in a very unique way.

articles.title: Champagne and Bullets belongs on the Mount Rushmore of bad movies

articles.learnerContent:
## Champagne and Bullets: A Masterpiece of Bad Cinema

Have you ever watched a movie that was so badly made that it became entertaining? Films like *The Room*, *Troll 2*, and *Fateful Findings* are famous examples of this strange phenomenon. Critics and fans often call them "so bad they're good" movies. Now, a film called *Champagne and Bullets* has joined this very special club.

### What Makes a Movie "So Bad It's Good"?

These types of films share some common traits. The people who make them usually have very big ambitions — they want to create something amazing. However, their resources, skills, and budgets often fall far short of those ambitions. The result is a movie that fails in many technical ways but succeeds in being wildly entertaining. Audiences enjoy watching things go wrong in unexpected and creative ways.

### One Man's Vision

*Champagne and Bullets* is a remarkable film for one main reason: almost everything in it was done by a single person. John De Hart wrote the screenplay, directed the movie, and also plays the lead character, Rick Bode. Taking on all three of these major roles is extremely difficult even for experienced professionals, and the results here are exactly as chaotic as you might expect.

But De Hart did not stop there. He also performs a musical number in the film — a strange and memorable song called "Shimmy Slide." This kind of unexpected moment is exactly what fans of outsider cinema love. It is bold, unusual, and completely sincere, even if the execution is far from polished.

### What Is Outsider Cinema?

"Outsider cinema" refers to films made outside the normal Hollywood system. These movies are usually created by people who do not have professional training or large budgets. Because of this, they often break the usual rules of filmmaking — sometimes accidentally, sometimes on purpose. The results can be confusing, funny, or surprisingly moving.

Classic examples of outsider cinema, like *The Room* by Tommy Wiseau, have developed enormous fan followings over the years. People watch them at midnight screenings, quote the dialogue, and celebrate the unique vision behind them. *Champagne and Bullets* appears to deserve a similar kind of attention.

### Is It Worth Watching?

If you enjoy movies that are unpredictable, strange, and full of energy — even if that energy is chaotic — then *Champagne and Bullets* might be perfect for you. The film was also released under two other titles: *GetEven* and *Road to Revenge*, which shows that it had a complicated journey to find its audience.

The movie is described as "bonkers enough to live up to its artwork," meaning that even the promotional images for the film are wild and unusual. For fans of cult movies and outsider art, this is high praise indeed.

Sometimes the most interesting creative works come from people who simply refuse to follow the rules — and *Champagne and Bullets* is a perfect example of that.

His ambition was clear, but he lacked the budget to achieve his vision.

## Water Returns to Gatwick Airport After Major Outage

Gatwick Airport is one of the busiest airports in the United Kingdom. It is located near London and serves millions of passengers every year. On July 26, 2026, the airport faced a very difficult day because of a major water outage.

**What Is a Water Outage?**

A water outage means that the water supply stops working. This can cause many problems in a large, busy place like an airport. Without water, toilets cannot be used and restaurants cannot prepare food or drinks.

**What Happened at Gatwick?**

On that day, toilets across the airport were closed because there was no water. Restaurants also had to close their doors to passengers. This caused a lot of disruption for travelers who were waiting for their flights.

Imagine arriving at an airport and not being able to use the bathroom or buy a meal. Many passengers were frustrated and confused. Airport staff worked hard to give people information and to fix the problem as quickly as possible.

**Why Does This Matter?**

Airports need clean water for many reasons. Water is needed in bathrooms, kitchens, and cleaning areas. When water stops, it affects the health and comfort of thousands of people at the same time.

Gatwick Airport can have more than 100,000 passengers on a busy day. So even a few hours without water can cause serious problems for a very large number of people.

**Water Returns**

The good news is that the water supply returned to normal by the end of the day. Toilets and restaurants were able to open again. The airport worked with engineers and water supply teams to fix the outage as quickly as possible.

Airport officials apologized to passengers for the inconvenience. They also said they would look into why the outage happened and how to prevent it in the future.

**Lessons Learned**

This event shows how important basic services like water are for a large public place. Airports, train stations, and shopping centers all depend on water to run smoothly. When something goes wrong, it can affect thousands of people very quickly.

For travelers, it is always a good idea to carry a water bottle and some snacks when going to an airport, just in case something unexpected happens.

Gatwick Airport is expected to continue operating normally after this disruption. Officials are working to make sure a similar problem does not happen again.

keyVocab.example: The water outage lasted for several hours and caused many problems at the airport.
The closed toilets caused a lot of disruption for passengers waiting for their flights.
Many travelers were frustrated because they could not use the bathroom.
The airport apologized to passengers for the inconvenience caused by the water outage.
Officials are working to prevent a similar problem from happening in the future.
